annotations.title: Respond to SOC 2, FedRAMP, NIST 800-171 & CMMC Security Questionnaires

description: Draft audit-ready responses to vendor security questionnaires (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP Moderate/High, NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2/3, CMMC 2.0, CAIQ/SIG/HECVAT) with cross-framework control citations, an estimated DoD SPRS score (-203 to 110), required evidence artifacts, and POA&M remediation items for any control gaps. This is a read-only, stateless advisory responder (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; maps each question in `questionnaire_text` against the vendor's `security_posture_summary`, while `target_framework` selects 'auto_detect' [default] or locks control citations to a specific standard and flags any unsupported controls as 'Partially Met' or 'POA&M Required' rather than fabricating compliance). Use this tool when completing customer due-diligence questionnaires, SSP control tables, or DoD SPRS self-assessments; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead to audit FAR/DFARS solicitation clauses, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general RFP Section C/L/M requirements.

questionnaire_text.description: Numbered or bulleted security questionnaire items from an enterprise SIG/CAIQ/HECVAT sheet, customer infosec assessment, or Federal RFP / NIST 800-171 SSP checklist.

security_posture_summary.description: Required summary of the vendor's actual security stack, cloud hosting (e.g., AWS GovCloud), active certifications (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP), encryption (FIPS 140-3, AES-256), MFA/IAM, and SIEM logging.

target_framework.description: Compliance control mapping mode: 'auto_detect' (default, infers framework from questionnaire text), 'soc2_iso27001' (AICPA TSC & ISO 27001 Annex A), 'nist_800_171_cmmc' (110 CMMC 2.0 Level 2 controls + DoD SPRS score calculation), 'fedramp_800_53' (NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5), or 'caiq_sig_hecvat'.

name: answer_security_questionnaire

detected_framework.description: Primary compliance standard applied to the responses.

estimated_dod_sprs_score.description: Calculated DoD SPRS score (-203 to 110) when NIST 800-171 / CMMC applies.

poam_remediation_items.description: Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) entries for partially met or unmet controls.

question_responses.description: Audit-ready answers with compliance status, control citations, and verification evidence.

title: Respond to SOC 2, FedRAMP, NIST 800-171 & CMMC Security Questionnaires
